isp: Hold HOLD to open both Pac-only barriers and start Gem's bubble stream.
After Pac clears both barriers, catch a bubble for FLOAT and steer onto the upper route.
pac: While Isp holds HOLD, use bubble top contacts to bounce past the far beam and door.
Reach Pac's lower matching exit, clearing both barriers before Isp releases HOLD.

common_mistakes.mistake: Pac catches a bubble on its side instead of its gold top, Isp misses a bubble needed for FLOAT, or Isp releases HOLD before Pac clears both barriers.
common_mistakes.consequence: A side hit gives Pac STICKY for 0.6 seconds; a missed bounce or FLOAT opportunity costs a projectile cycle on the continuous floor. Releasing HOLD closes both Pac-only barriers and blocks progress, but the room has no physical hazard.
common_mistakes.recovery: Wait out STICKY if it occurred, reposition, and use a later bubble. Isp keeps or reoccupies HOLD until Pac passes both barriers, then catches a later bubble for FLOAT. These are source-inferred retries, not current44 observations.
